summary: Iter190 Messages extras tested end-to-end (backend pytest + Playwright desktop 1920, mobile 390, Spanish). Contact notes/tags, tag filter, search on notes/tags, scheduled texts (validation, cancel, 20s worker send to CA, failure to US 10DLC -> status failed + error + Inbox webNotifications kind sms + no charge), AI summary (real OpenAI) with <=3 replies, null for <10 events, no replies when canText false, all work. 'For you' removed from sidebar and mobile More. One backend bug: ?tag filter is bypassed when ?q also matches notes/tags of other contacts. iter189 regression (non-replace subset) 12/12 pass.

minor.issue: The tag filter runs before the notes/tags search adds extra threads (messages.js lines 151-158). Those added threads skip the tag check, so ?tag=Lead&q=test_kiwi returned +15125550199 (no Lead tag) because its notes matched. Fix: apply the tag filter after the q merge, or filter `all` by tag too. In the UI this happens when the user picks a tag and also types a search.

If the OpenAI call fails (ai() returns null), no summary doc is written. With cur null there is no 2-minute throttle, so every 8 s poll retries OpenAI and the card stays on 'Summarizing…' forever. Store a failure timestamp so retries are throttled too.

A doc stays in status 'sending' forever if the process crashes mid-send; nothing recovers it. schedule() also doesn't check that the media ids exist or fit the size limit, so bad media only fails at send time. Both are low risk.
contact isn't checked against the account's threads (any string is upserted). Minor.

integration_issues.issue: Shows threads without the selected tag (backend bug above)

issues: Header is very cramped. The contact number is cut to '+1416…', and the 'to +1334… · Calling number', caps chips and tag chips stack in one column about 220px tall. With the Notes panel open, almost no event area is left. Suggestion: move caps/tags to one horizontal scrolling row, or hide caps on mobile.
The calendar popover is hard-coded dark (#141414) while the app is in light theme. Time uses the browser's native input type=time ('-- : -- --').
The success toast at bottom-right sits over the scheduled-cancel button area right after scheduling. 'Not sent' failed items can't be dismissed (they stay 3 days).

Suggested replies can contain placeholders such as '[link]'; tell the prompt to avoid placeholders. The card sits at the top of thread-events, so on long threads it's out of view after the auto-scroll to the bottom.

action_items: Fix GET /messages so ?tag still applies to threads added by the notes/tags search
Throttle AI summary retries when OpenAI fails (store a failure 'at')
Improve the mobile thread header layout (tags + caps chips)
Make the DateTimePicker popover follow the theme (light mode)
Optional: prompt the AI to avoid placeholders like [link]; recover stuck 'sending' scheduled docs

rca of the issue: Tag+q bug: in messages.js routes() GET /messages, `threads` is filtered by tag at line 151. The q-meta branch (lines 153-158) then appends `all` threads whose notes/tags match q without re-applying the tag. Repro: tag +15125550199 notes 'TEST_kiwi', then GET /messages?tag=Lead&q=test_kiwi -> it's included. Fix: run `if (tag) threads = threads.filter(...)` after the q merge.
